# Effects, transitions, generators, templates, styles

The built-in catalog (every entry is a plugin-API definition in `src/builtin/`; plugins add more). `mgl docs <name>` prints one.

## Effects

`fx` on a clip is an ordered list: `mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.add shot1 type=blur radius=8`; address a parameter as
`fx.blur.radius` (first of that type) or `fx.0.radius`. Numeric parameters accept keyframes. Stage `source` runs in ffmpeg while
decoding (media clips only); `layer` runs in Skia on the rendered layer.

- **blur** (layer): Gaussian blur of the layer (radius in px).  
  `radius?` number = `10`; `edges?` "extend"\|"transparent" = `"extend"` · extend repeats edge pixels so full-frame video keeps solid borders; transparent lets the blur spread past the layer box
- **glow** (layer): Soft light around the bright parts of the layer (screen-blended blur on top of it).  
  `radius?` number = `20`; `strength?` number = `1`; `threshold?` number = `0` · only pixels brighter than this (0..1 luma) glow; `color?` string · tint the glow with this colour (default: the layer's own colours)
- **shadow** (layer): Drop shadow behind the layer, offset by x/y px and softened by blur px.  
  `x?` number = `8`; `y?` number = `8`; `blur?` number = `16`; `color?` string = `"#000000"`; `opacity?` number = `0.6`
- **vignette** (layer): Darkens (or tints) the layer towards its corners with an elliptical falloff.  
  `amount?` number = `0.5` · opacity of the colour at the corners; `softness?` number = `0.5` · 0 = hard edge near the corners, 1 = falloff from the centre; `color?` string = `"#000000"`
- **chroma-key** (layer): Makes pixels close to the key colour transparent (green/blue screen) and removes colour spill.  
  `color?` string = `"#00ff00"`; `tolerance?` number = `0.3` · chroma distance keyed fully transparent; `softness?` number = `0.1` · chroma distance over which alpha ramps back to opaque; `spill?` number = `0.5` · how much key-colour spill to remove from kept pixels
- **color** (source + layer): Colour correction: brightness, contrast, saturation, hue rotation, temperature and tint.  
  `brightness?` number = `0`; `contrast?` number = `1`; `saturation?` number = `1`; `hue?` number = `0` · hue rotation in degrees; `temperature?` number = `0` · -1 cool (blue) .. 1 warm (orange); `tint?` number = `0` · -1 green .. 1 magenta
- **lut** (source): Applies a 3D colour lookup table (.cube) to a media clip while it is decoded.  
  `file` string · path to the LUT, relative to the project file; `interp?` "nearest"\|"trilinear"\|"tetrahedral" = `"tetrahedral"`
- **denoise** (source + layer): Reduces video noise on media clips (ffmpeg hqdn3d); other layers get a light smoothing blur.  
  `strength?` number = `0.5`
- **sharpen** (source + layer): Sharpens detail with an unsharp mask (ffmpeg unsharp on media; the same maths on other layers).  
  `amount?` number = `0.8`
- **grain** (layer): Film grain: seeded random noise that changes every frame (deterministic for a seed and frame).  
  `amount?` number = `0.15`; `size?` int = `1` · grain size in px; `mono?` boolean = `true` · same noise on all channels (false = coloured grain); `seed?` int = `0`
- **pixelate** (layer): Mosaic: averages the layer into square blocks of size px.  
  `size?` number = `16`
- **stroke** (layer): Outline around the layer's visible shape (its alpha), width px outside the edge.  
  `width?` number = `4`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `opacity?` number = `1`
- **mirror** (layer): Flips the layer (flip), or reflects its first half onto the second (reflect), along an axis.  
  `axis?` "horizontal"\|"vertical"\|"both" = `"horizontal"` · horizontal swaps left and right; vertical swaps top and bottom; `mode?` "flip"\|"reflect" = `"flip"`
- **invert** (layer): Inverts the layer's colours (amount 1 = full negative), keeping its alpha.  
  `amount?` number = `1`
- **rgb-split** (layer): Chromatic aberration: shifts the red channel one way and blue the other by amount px.  
  `amount?` number = `6`; `angle?` number = `0` · direction of the red shift in degrees (0 = right)

## Transitions

A transition is the incoming clip's `in` (centred on the cut): `mgl edit video.mgl.json transition.set shot2 type=wipe len=0.5s`.

- **crossfade**: Dissolves the outgoing clip into the incoming one.
- **dip**: Fades the outgoing clip to a colour (black by default), then the colour to the incoming clip.  
  `color?` string = `"black"` · black, white or any CSS colour such as #1a1a1a
- **wipe**: A moving edge reveals the incoming clip; direction is where the edge travels.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`; `softness?` number = `0` · width of the soft edge as a fraction of the frame
- **slide**: The incoming clip slides in over the outgoing one, moving in the given direction.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`
- **push**: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing one out of frame, both moving in the given direction.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`
- **zoom**: Zooms into the outgoing clip while the incoming one settles from zoomed-in to normal, dissolving between them.  
  `scale?` number = `1.5` · zoom factor at the cut
- **blur**: Blurs the outgoing clip, dissolves at peak blur, and unblurs the incoming clip.  
  `radius?` number = `30` · blur radius in px at the cut
- **spin**: The outgoing clip spins and shrinks away while the incoming clip spins and grows in.  
  `turns?` number = `1` · total turns over the transition (negative = counter-clockwise)
- **flash**: A bright flash of colour (white by default) that peaks at the cut.  
  `color?` string = `"white"`

## Generators

Clips that draw: `{"gen": {"type": "gradient", "colors": ["#000", "#333"]}}`.

- **gradient**: Linear or radial colour gradient background, optionally rotating over time.  
  `colors?` string[] = `["#1e3c72","#2a5298"]` · two or more colours, evenly spaced; `angle?` number = `90` · direction of a linear gradient in degrees (0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom); `type?` "linear"\|"radial" = `"linear"`; `animate?` number = `0` · degrees per second: rotates a linear gradient, orbits a radial one
- **noise**: Animated smooth noise field (clouds, smoke, grain-field backgrounds) mapped onto a colour ramp.  
  `scale?` number = `160` · feature size in px; `speed?` number = `0.5` · how fast the field evolves (cycles per second); `seed?` int = `0`; `octaves?` int = `3`; `colors?` string[] = `["#000000","#ffffff"]`
- **particles**: Deterministic drifting particles (dust, snow, bubbles, embers) that wrap around the frame.  
  `count?` int = `80`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `size?` number = `6` · particle diameter in px; `speed?` number = `120` · px per second; `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"up"`; `seed?` int = `0`; `shape?` "circle"\|"square" = `"circle"`; `jitter?` number = `0.5` · variation of size and speed between particles; `twinkle?` number = `0.3` · how much each particle's opacity pulses
- **progress-bar**: A bar along the top or bottom edge that fills from 0 to 100% over duration frames.  
  `duration?` int = `300` · frames to go from empty to full (usually the clip length); `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `background?` string = `"rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"`; `height?` number = `12`; `position?` "top"\|"bottom" = `"bottom"`; `inset?` number = `0` · distance from the edge in px
- **counter**: A number that counts from `from` to `to` over duration frames (stats, prices, countdowns).  
  `from?` number = `0`; `to?` number = `100`; `duration?` int = `60` · frames to reach `to`; it then holds; `decimals?` int = `0`; `prefix?` string = `""`; `suffix?` string = `""`; `separator?` string = `""` · thousands separator, e.g. ","; `easing?` "linear"\|"ease-out"\|"ease-in-out" = `"ease-out"`; `font?` string = `"Inter"`; `weight?` int = `700`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `size?` number = `160` · font size in px
- **checker**: Checkerboard background (optionally rotated and scrolling).  
  `size?` number = `64` · cell size in px; `angle?` number = `0`; `speed?` number = `0` · scroll speed in px per second; `colors?` string[] = `["#1f1f1f","#2e2e2e"]`
- **pattern**: Repeating background pattern: checker, stripes, dots or grid, optionally rotated and scrolling.  
  `kind?` "checker"\|"stripes"\|"dots"\|"grid" = `"stripes"`; `size?` number = `64` · cell size in px; `angle?` number = `0`; `speed?` number = `0` · scroll speed in px per second; `colors?` string[] = `["#111111","#222222"]` · background colour, then pattern colour; `lineWidth?` number = `2` · grid line width in px

## Templates

`mgl edit video.mgl.json template.apply <id> at=1s params='{...}'` (see templates.md).

- **intro**: Title card: background, accent shapes, a popping title and a subtitle that slides up (4 s).  
  `title?` string = `"Your title here"`; `subtitle?` string = `""`; `bg?` string = `"#101014"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **lower-third**: Name and role on a dark plate with an accent bar, bottom left; wipes in and out (5 s).  
  `name?` string = `"Jane Doe"`; `role?` string = `""`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `plate?` string = `"#000000b3"`
- **cta**: Call-to-action button (rounded rect + label) that pops in and bounces, inside the safe zone (3 s).  
  `label?` string = `"Subscribe"`; `color?` string = `"#ff0033"`; `textColor?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `y?` number = `0.8` · vertical position inside the safe area, 0 = top, 1 = bottom
- **title**: A big centred title that pops in word by word and fades out (3 s).  
  `text?` string = `"Big title"`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`
- **end-card**: End screen: background, title, two video placeholders and a subtitle (5 s).  
  `title?` string = `"Thanks for watching"`; `subtitle?` string = `"Subscribe for more"`; `bg?` string = `"#101014"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **progress-bar**: A bar that fills from left to right over the comp length (or len), at the top or bottom of the safe area.  
  `color?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `trackColor?` string = `"#ffffff33"`; `position?` "top"\|"bottom" = `"bottom"`; `thickness?` number = `12`
- **quote**: A quotation with a large accent quote mark and the author underneath (5 s).  
  `quote?` string = `"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication."`; `author?` string = `""`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **listicle-item**: A numbered list item: a number in an accent circle and the item text (3 s).  
  `number?` int = `1`; `text?` string = `"List item"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `numberColor?` string = `"#111111"`

## Styles

Built-in text styles, usable as `"style": "<id>"` or as `base` of your own style.

- **title**: Big bold title: Anton 120, white with a black stroke. `{"font":"Anton","size":120,"weight":"normal","color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":8,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.05}`
- **subtitle**: Secondary line under a title: Inter 56 semibold, soft shadow. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":600,"color":"#ffffff","shadow":"#00000099","shadowBlur":8,"shadowOffset":[0,3],"align":"center","lineHeight":1.2}`
- **caption**: Readable captions: Inter 64 bold, white with a black stroke, 900 px wide, 2 lines. `{"font":"Inter","size":64,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":6,"maxWidth":900,"maxLines":2,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.15}`
- **karaoke**: Captions with the spoken word highlighted in yellow. `{"base":"caption","highlight":"#ffd400"}`
- **pop**: Loud punchy words: Inter Black 96, yellow with a black stroke, upper case. `{"font":"Inter","size":96,"weight":900,"color":"#ffd400","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":8,"uppercase":true,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.05}`
- **boxed**: Dark text on a white rounded box. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":"bold","color":"#111111","bg":"#ffffff","bgPadding":[28,14],"bgRadius":18,"align":"center"}`
- **lower-third**: Name line of a lower third: Inter 52 bold, left aligned. `{"font":"Inter","size":52,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","align":"left","shadow":"#00000080","shadowBlur":6}`
- **cta**: Call-to-action label: Inter Black 56, white, upper case. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":900,"color":"#ffffff","uppercase":true,"align":"center","letterSpacing":1}`
- **label**: Small tag on a translucent dark box. `{"font":"Inter","size":36,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","bg":"#000000b3","bgPadding":[16,8],"bgRadius":8,"align":"center"}`
- **body**: Body text: Inter 44 regular, relaxed line height. `{"font":"Inter","size":44,"weight":"normal","color":"#ffffff","lineHeight":1.35,"align":"center"}`

## Text animations

`text.animate <clip> in=<id> by=word` (char, word, line, all).

**none** (No animation (shown at rest).) · **fade** (Fade in.) · **pop** (Scale 0.6 → 1.08 → 1 with a quick fade: a punchy overshoot.) · **slide-up** (Rise 40 px into place while fading in.) · **slide-down** (Drop 40 px into place while fading in.) · **slide-left** (Slide in 60 px from the right while fading in.) · **typewriter** (Each unit appears at once (use by: "char").) · **blur-in** (Sharpen from a 12 px blur while fading in.) · **bounce** (Fall 60 px and bounce to rest.) · **scale-in** (Grow from 0 to full size while fading in.) · **drop** (Drop 80 px from above with a slight overshoot.) · **wave** (Each unit hops up 24 px and lands (stagger makes a wave).)
